# koyamarium — Writing, learning, books & photographs

> Public portfolio. 日本語 / English. Cite the specific source page when summarizing or quoting.

- [Home](https://koyamarium.github.io/): Portfolio entry points and public contact.
- [Learning & web works](https://koyamarium.github.io/research/): Current public learning resources and web works.
- [Theoretical astrophysics](https://koyamarium.github.io/astronomy-step-by-step/): Bilingual teaching materials.
- [Optical systems](https://koyamarium.github.io/optics/): Optical-system gallery.
- [Market Chart Atlas](https://koyamarium.github.io/market-chart-atlas/): Educational technical-indicator gallery; retrospective examples are not investment recommendations.
- [Books](https://koyamarium.github.io/books/): Book descriptions and external purchase/sample links.
- [Photographs](https://koyamarium.github.io/photographs/): Public viewing copies.
- [Rights & reuse](https://koyamarium.github.io/rights/): Original implementation code is MIT; text, images, books and third-party materials have separate terms. AI search, summaries and source-linked quotation are welcome within those terms.
